parts:
Hope you are staying safe and sane.

BLOG
Check out the Konfound-it BLOG (https://www.konfound-it.org/). Thanks to Qinyun Lin and Spiro Maroulis for getting this off the ground!  
It has COVID related analyses of HCQ and remdesivir.



Professional development.
Roughly 140+ participants in the AERA professional development.  Thanks to all those who supported. Qinyun Lin, Zixi Chen, Yuqing Liu, Guan Saw, Tenglong Li, Spiro Maroulis, Ran Xu, Josh Rosenberg.

Video will be available in coming weeks.  For more info.

Next workshop may be in August associated with American Sociological Association.

Happy Memorial Day!


Ken
